title: Assistant Professor, Agricultural Economics and Agribusiness
description:
Job Title

Assistant Professor, Agricultural Economics and Agribusiness

Essential Job Functions

Conducts a requisite number of classes; Teaches assigned
subjects
Provides guidance and supervision to students
Creates and maintains an environment conducive to excellence in
teaching, learning and research
Preparation and formulation of curricula focused on his/her
subject(s)
Participates in departmental meetings and holds scheduled
office hours
Maintains equipment in the laboratory, makes arrangements for
laboratory practical sessions, and provides materials to
students
Provides academic support to other faculty members
Serves on departmental and University committees, as
assigned
Demonstrates grantsmanship and ability to publish in peer
review journals
Other related duties, as assigned

Qualifications

Doctor of Philosophy in Agricultural Economics, Applied
Economics, or Economics with background in Agriculture or
Agribusiness
Five (5) years’ teaching experience at the college or
university level

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

In-depth knowledge of agricultural economics and
agribusiness
Demonstrated integrity
Excellent communication skills, verbal, written and
interpersonal
Strong time management skills
Passion for teaching and engaging with students
Skilled in mentoring students
Ability to work well with colleagues and foster a collegial
environment conducive to teamwork and students’ high level of
learning
